summary: Preserved the dependency-free Python 3D ray/AABB distance implementation and added explicit face-tangency and comprehensive non-finite input regressions. Source compilation, 21 synthetic unittest tests, and usage smoke checks passed. Documentation is English. This is an infrastructure pipeline smoke test, not a paper or device demonstration. Test commands run from papers/pipeline-smoke/.

limitations: Uses Python floating-point arithmetic; extreme coordinate differences or distances may overflow, and extreme direction component ratios may underflow.
Synthetic software validation only; no research-paper reproduction or physical-device claim. No external access is required and no large artifacts are produced.
